## Findings
- claim-1: For \(J=[333,5^5]\subset\Lambda/I_{5,5}\), the accepted Smith witnesses give \(\operatorname{rank}Q_d=(1,1,2,2,2,1,1,0,\ldots,0)\) for \(d=9,\ldots,25\), and \(\operatorname{Tor}(Q_d)=0\) in every such degree. [artifact b5658ec18b84ad470751544a752f238dadd447fb7b1122a89a299a79e024042f]
- claim-2: For \(P_{a,b}(z):=\sum_{\rho\subseteq b^a}z^{|\rho|}\), one has \(P_{a,b}=P_{a-1,b}+z^aP_{a,b-1}\), with \(P_{0,b}=P_{a,0}=1\). Hence \(P_{2,3}=1+z+2z^2+2z^3+2z^4+z^5+z^6=\binom52_z\).
- claim-3: The lower-adjoined family indexed by \(\rho\subseteq b^a\) minimally generates the indicated basic ideal. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 220-235]
## Strategy
Use the symbolic rectangle-partition recurrence
\[
P_{a,b}(z):=\sum_{\rho\subseteq b^a}z^{|\rho|}
=P_{a-1,b}(z)+z^aP_{a,b-1}(z),
\quad P_{0,b}=P_{a,0}=1.
\]
Splitting by whether \(\rho\) has \(<a\) positive parts or exactly \(a\) proves it. Thus
\[
P_{2,3}(z)=1+z+2z^2+2z^3+2z^4+z^5+z^6=\binom52_z.
\]
The accepted Smith witnesses for \(J=[333,5^5]\) give free ranks
\[
(1,1,2,2,2,1,1,0,\ldots,0)
\]
in degrees \(9,\ldots,25\), with no torsion factors. Hence the requested computed-case target is established:
\[
\operatorname{Hilb}_Q(z)=z^9P_{2,3}(z)=z^9\binom52_z.
\]

## Gaps
The recurrence only enumerates partitions in \(3^2\). It does not prove that these partitions form an integral basis of \(J/A_+J\) in general. Minimal generation does not by itself exclude integral torsion in indecomposables. Thus no general Hilbert-series or torsion-freeness theorem, and no original uniform integral certificate, is established.

## Next
The smallest remaining obstruction is an integral argument identifying the enumerated minimal family with a torsion-free basis of indecomposables; no further large computation is warranted here.
